content.bridge_context: We learn to organize the objects around us by identifying their physical properties, a fundamental skill in scientific inquiry.

units.title: Properties of Materials
units.explanation: Materials can be grouped based on appearance (lustre), hardness, solubility, and transparency.
units.dual_language_instruction: Look at objects like a pencil, an eraser, and a bottle. Describe them. / पेंसिल, इरेज़र और बोतल जैसी वस्तुओं को देखें। उनका वर्णन करें।

units.title: Need for Grouping
units.explanation: Grouping makes it easy to locate things and study their properties systematically.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss how things are arranged in a library or a shop. / चर्चा करें कि पुस्तकालय या दुकान में चीजें कैसे व्यवस्थित होती हैं।
